sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: A single blank ivory sheet on a dark wooden desk has physically unfolded into a vast exquisitely detailed miniature ocean world: tiny ivory origami sailboat with one triangular sail, curling deep blue water and warm amber horizon rise from the paper. Dramatic macro-to-wide photograph, readable one continuous impossible paper sculpture, dark studio background, one idea becoming a world, tactile paper, realistic water, restrained premium cinematic lighting. No text, no screen, no technology icons.
